what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A web of trust for careers: keys in people's own repositories, two-way links, countersigned jobs and degrees.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Keys and repositories, two-way links, countersignatures, link lists, agents walk the graph, a business.

sections.label: The problem
sections.line: No good way to check who worked or studied where, and connections that mean little.

sections.label: What we already have
sections.line: pki.sgit.ai, its four rules from the 2019 keyserver failure, agent keys and QR codes already exist.

sections.label: Identities, in repositories
sections.line: Several identities per person, keys in a repository they control, the one behind their site.

sections.label: Links that go both ways
sections.line: Sign by QR in person; a link counts only when both sides publish it; one-way links mean nothing.

sections.label: Who worked where
sections.line: The person claims a job or a degree; the company or university countersigns; nothing published unasked.

sections.label: Link lists, not revocation lists
sections.line: Publish what is valid: a link holds while both sides still publish it; git keeps the history.

sections.label: Following the graph
sections.line: Checks are plain reads, so following the graph scales; each person's AI does the work.

sections.label: No recommendations
sections.line: Connections and confirmations only; credibility from the shape of the graph.

sections.label: Inside every organisation
sections.line: Every organisation needs one internally: staff, roles and agents, signed and versioned.

sections.label: A LinkedIn for Europe
sections.line: A professional network for Europe where nobody owns the graph, alongside the EU wallet and credentials.

sections.label: A business somebody should build
sections.line: Free for people; organisations pay to confirm; verification as a service; an internal edition.

sections.label: Names
sections.line: Countersign, Mutual, Vouch, Trellis, Nexo; Countersign for the mechanism, Mutual for the network.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: A proposal on existing pieces; the step count an estimate; no countersigned job yet.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: My thinking, pki.sgit.ai's rules and history, and the standards, on 21 November 2026.
